## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run typecheck` and `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md is updated under `## [Unreleased]`, or the change isn't one users can notice
- [ ] UI text is plain Indonesian (and English) in [GLOSSARY.md](https://github.com/rantakit/rantakit/blob/main/GLOSSARY.md) wording, in both `src/i18n/id.ts` and `src/i18n/en.ts`
- [ ] No new network calls besides the update check and language downloads the user asks for ([ADR 0001](https://github.com/rantakit/rantakit/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-files-never-leave-the-device.md))
- [ ] The Original is never modified, moved, or overwritten; every Result is a new file
